meta.description: Conversion and equivalence factors used by the FridgeSense impact engine.
meta.note: Per-food carbon, water and price factors live in food_catalog.csv. This file holds only the global constants used to translate saved food into human-readable equivalences.
sources: Poore, J. & Nemecek, T. (2018). Reducing food's environmental impacts through producers and consumers. Science 360(6392) - cradle-to-retail GHG medians by food category.
Mekonnen, M.M. & Hoekstra, A.Y. (2011). The green, blue and grey water footprint of crops and derived crop products. Hydrology and Earth System Sciences 15 - total water footprints.
UNEP Food Waste Index Report 2024 - household food waste ~79 kg per capita per year; food waste responsible for 8-10% of global GHG emissions.
FAO (2011/2019) - roughly one third of food produced for human consumption is lost or wasted.
USDA FoodKeeper and FSSAI storage guidance - refrigerated and frozen shelf-life ranges.
India GHG Program / IPCC AR6 - passenger car emission intensity.

baselines.note: Used to compute the counterfactual 'what you would have wasted' baseline before a user has enough personal history.
